tools.name: find_venues
tools.description: Find the Youngster venues (libraries, community centres) nearest to a place in Australia, nearest first, each with its next session date. With no place given, lists venues with the soonest sessions first.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List a venue's upcoming sessions, each with its slots and how many seats are left in each. A slot with seats_left 0 is full. Times are local to the venue.

tools.name: book_slot
tools.description: Book one senior into one slot of a session. Only with the senior's agreement. The reply is the confirmation (booked: true, with the venue, address, date and time to tell the person). Bookings cannot be changed or cancelled here; to change or cancel, call Youngster on 1300 774 711.
